developmentBacklogAdded.name: Remote geo-exclusion parser
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Remote labels can be misleading when the employer excludes the candidate's home region or limits remote eligibility to specific regions, creating false-positive remote recommendations.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Parse positive and negative geography clauses from full-detail employer pages and require explicit candidate-region compatibility before assigning remote-ok.

developmentBacklogAdded.name: Fresh-post skill-gap budget
developmentBacklogAdded.problem: Very fresh jobs can deserve fast review, but hard-skill gaps such as PHP/server management can still make them poor applications; freshness alone can over-rank them.
developmentBacklogAdded.improvement: Compute a bounded skill-gap budget that allows only one trainable adjacent gap for <24h opportunities while hard mandatory stacks remain disqualifying, reducing wasted applications without missing learnable roles.
